ticket.objective: Fix the three REAL desyncs coverage-audit run 2 found (report: specs/results/epic-close/coverage_audit_report.md), plus the owner-approved retention-basis amendment that licenses the resulting complexity decrease. (G2) The model still represents the withdrawn blocking complexity gate: TlaSpecDevCli.tla ~528 guards on complexity_gate = "fail" /\ override, and the override input survives, while the program has been advisory since MF-036/CD-01 and proceeds-on-fail with no flag (generate_cases_from_tlc_dump.py 866-882). Make the model advisory-faithful: remove the override variable and every blocking branch; the recorded verdict state may remain as an observable fact. (G4) AnalyzeComplexity declares a tlc_process port (*java*) but the analyze path spawns nothing — remove the dead port declaration from the action (and the port if unused). (G5) case_adapters.toml binds 11 of 14 model actions plus ValidateTestGraphCli which is not an action — reconcile bindings to the exact action set (bind the missing, drop the non-action), with spec-unit tests proving the mapping. (RETENTION AMENDMENT, owner-approved 2026-07-22:) amend scripts/complexity_ledger.py so a complexity DECREASE is licensed by the CD-02 validated-refactor basis — TLC green before/after, behavior tests green, before/after descriptors compared, transition-level diff inspected (the existing red-flag gate) — with the fuzzing-era retention members (kill_rate, effect_conformance, external_coverage) still RECORDED (not_run / experimental) but no longer gating; they were demoted by the pivot after measuring kill 0.31 vs floor 0.8 and 0/9 content bugs. Update tests/test_complexity_ledger.py accordingly; record the doctrine change where the ledger doctrine is documented. This ticket's own close is the first exercise of the amended basis — record the full validated-refactor evidence set.
